details: GET /api/miniapp/admin/check/123456789 returns is_admin=true with permissions
GET /api/miniapp/admin/check/9999999999 returns is_admin=false for non-admin
GET /api/miniapp/admin/stats/123456789 returns revenue, subscribers counts, pending payments count
Returns 403 for non-admin users
GET /api/miniapp/admin/pending-payments/123456789 returns list of pending payments
Returns 403 for non-admin users
POST /api/miniapp/admin/payment-action with approve action updates payment status to verified
POST /api/miniapp/admin/payment-action with reject action updates payment status to rejected
Returns 400 for invalid action, 403 for non-admin
GET /api/miniapp/admin/subscribers/123456789 returns subscribers list
Returns 403 for non-admin users
POST /api/miniapp/admin/broadcast sends message to all users
Returns broadcast_id and total_recipients count
Returns 400 for empty message, 403 for non-admin
GET /api/miniapp/admin/live-sessions/123456789 returns live sessions list
POST /api/miniapp/admin/live-session creates a new live session
Returns 403 for non-admin users
POST /api/miniapp/admin/announce-live/{session_id} announces a live session
Returns sent_to count
Returns 404 for invalid session
Admin tab visible in bottom navigation for admin user (123456789)
Admin tab NOT visible for non-admin user (9999999999)
Admin Panel shows Stats, Payments, Broadcast, Live, Users sub-tabs
Stats sub-tab shows 4 stat cards (Revenue, Active Subs, Total Users, Pending)
Payments sub-tab shows pending payments with Approve/Reject buttons
Broadcast sub-tab has textarea and Send Broadcast button
Live sub-tab has Create Live Session button and session list
Users sub-tab shows subscribers list
Plan selection shows inline payment section below the selected plan card
Payment section includes coupon input, Razorpay button, UPI Manual Payment button
